frontend.question: What is the difference between var, let and const?
Explain closures with a practical example.
frontend.hint: A function remembering variables from where it was created.

frontend.question: How does the event loop handle promises and setTimeout?
frontend.hint: Call stack, microtask queue, macrotask queue.

frontend.question: What is the difference between state and props?
frontend.hint: Who owns the data and who can change it.

frontend.question: When would you use useMemo and useCallback, and when not?
frontend.hint: Measure first; memoisation has a cost.

frontend.question: How do you avoid unnecessary re-renders in a large list?
How would you split a large app into micro-frontends?
frontend.hint: Module federation, shared dependencies, routing, team ownership.

frontend.question: A page has a poor LCP score. How do you investigate and fix it?
frontend.hint: Measure, find the LCP element, images, render-blocking resources, server time.

frontend.question: How do you choose between client state, server state and URL state?
How do you make a custom dropdown accessible?
frontend.hint: Keyboard support, roles, focus management, labels.

frontend.question: What do you test with unit tests versus end-to-end tests?

backend.question: What is the difference between PUT and PATCH?
backend.hint: Full replace versus partial update; idempotency.

backend.question: How would you design pagination for a large table?
What is an index and when can it hurt?
backend.hint: Faster reads, slower writes, extra storage.

backend.question: How do you store passwords and handle authentication?
backend.hint: Hashing with salt, tokens or sessions, expiry.

backend.question: How would you make an endpoint that calls a slow third-party service reliable?
backend.hint: Timeouts, retries with backoff, queues, circuit breaker.

backend.question: When would you choose microservices over a monolith?
backend.hint: Team size, deploy independence, operational cost.

backend.question: How do you keep data consistent across services?
backend.hint: Events, outbox pattern, sagas, idempotent consumers.

backend.question: Where would you add caching and how do you invalidate it?

fullstack.question: Walk through what happens from a button click to data saved in the database.
fullstack.hint: Event, request, validation, query, response, UI update.

fullstack.question: REST or GraphQL: how do you decide?
How would you build login with JWT and refresh tokens?
fullstack.hint: Short-lived access token, secure storage, rotation.

fullstack.question: How do you fetch data in React and show loading and error states?
fullstack.hint: Effect or query library, three states.

fullstack.question: When would you use SQL and when NoSQL?
fullstack.hint: Relations and transactions versus flexible documents.

fullstack.question: How do you ship a database change without downtime?
How do you structure a codebase that both frontend and backend teams work in?
What are XSS and CSRF and how do you prevent them?

ai.question: What are tokens and why do context limits matter?
Explain retrieval-augmented generation step by step.
How do you choose chunk size and overlap?
ai.hint: Document type, retrieval quality, test with real questions.

ai.question: Answers from your RAG app are wrong. How do you debug it?
ai.hint: Check retrieval first, then the prompt, then the model.

ai.question: How do you evaluate an LLM feature before and after release?
ai.hint: Test sets, graded examples, user feedback, regression checks.

ai.question: How do you reduce hallucinations?
ai.hint: Grounding in sources, clear instructions, allow "I do not know".

ai.question: How do you control latency and cost in an LLM product?
ai.hint: Caching, smaller models for simple steps, streaming.

ai.question: What is overfitting and how do you detect it?
When is an agent the right design, and when is a fixed pipeline better?

data.question: What is the difference between INNER JOIN and LEFT JOIN?
Explain window functions with an example.
A key metric dropped 20% overnight. What do you check?
data.hint: Data pipeline first, then segments, then real causes.

data.question: How do you make a data pipeline safe to re-run?
What is the difference between mean and median, and when does it matter?
Batch or streaming: how do you decide?
data.hint: Freshness needs versus cost and complexity.

devops.question: What is the difference between an image and a container?
A pod keeps restarting. How do you debug it?
Describe a deployment pipeline you would trust.
devops.hint: Build, test, scan, deploy in stages, rollback.

devops.question: What are SLIs, SLOs and error budgets?
How do you run an incident and the review afterwards?
How do you design for a region failure?

mobile.question: Explain the app lifecycle on your platform.
How does React Native talk to native code?
mobile.hint: Bridge or new architecture, native modules.

mobile.question: A list scrolls badly. What do you check?
How would you design offline support with sync?
mobile.hint: Local store, queue of changes, conflict rules.

mobile.question: How do you roll out a risky feature?
mobile.hint: Feature flags, staged rollout, crash monitoring.

mobile.question: How do you share code between iOS, Android and web?
mobile.hint: What to share and what to keep native.

qa.question: What is the difference between severity and priority?
What makes a test flaky and how do you fix it?
qa.hint: Timing, shared data, real waits versus fixed sleeps.

qa.question: How do you decide what to automate?
How do you test an API?
qa.hint: Status codes, schema, edge cases, auth.

qa.question: Explain the test pyramid.
qa.hint: Many unit tests, fewer integration, few end-to-end.

qa.question: How do you build quality into a team that ships daily?
qa.hint: Shift left, CI gates, ownership by developers.

design.question: Walk through your design process on a recent project.
How do you run a usability test?
design.hint: Tasks, real users, observe, do not lead.

design.question: How do you build and maintain a design system?
How do you design for accessibility?
design.hint: Contrast, focus, text size, not colour alone.

design.question: How do you hand off designs to developers?
How do you measure whether a design worked?

product.question: How do you decide what to build next?
How would you define success for a new feature?
How do you find out what users need?
A launch is two weeks late. What do you do?
product.hint: Cut scope, communicate early, protect quality.

product.question: How do you say no to a senior stakeholder?
How would you design an A/B test?
product.hint: Hypothesis, sample size, duration, one change.

behavioural.question: Tell me about yourself and your current role.
behavioural.hint: Two minutes: present, past, why this role.

behavioural.question: Describe a difficult problem you solved recently.
behavioural.hint: Situation, action, result — with numbers if you can.

behavioural.question: Tell me about a time you disagreed with a teammate.
behavioural.hint: Focus on how it was resolved.

behavioural.question: Why do you want to leave your current job?
behavioural.hint: Stay positive; talk about what you want next.
